goal: Cut the active equipment page over to canonical Selection Intent and server Resolved Snapshot facts with race-safe structured problem handling, while preserving browse affordances and legacy compatibility surfaces.
userValue: Players can edit and confirm equipment with clear pending, blocked, conflict, unavailable and offline states, and only a matching server-verified configuration can be saved or handed to Profile and SimC.
nonGoals: No page redesign or second frontend state framework
No client ownership of legality, Tier identity, set counts, deterministic totals, constraints or profile readiness
No backend contract, database migration, write, sync, backfill, cleanup, job, Worker, service or timer change
No Phase 5 stat execution worker or async pending implementation beyond transport compatibility
No formal Phase 4 Active Season Manifest or release registry
No public baseline, recommendation, DPS comparison or BiS behavior
No fabricated blocked-state screenshot or static/browser-only claim as real mini-program evidence

mustChange: one exact Selection Intent serializer from resolverContext and current choices
one confirmAndResolveGearIntent path for every existing confirmation/import/reset flow
active detail page ownership of the pure Slice 3B workbench state outside setData
final attribute, set, legality, constraint and readiness views formatted only from Resolved Snapshot
save/Profile/SimC gates bound to current Intent version and resolved signature
bounded pending, blocked, revision-conflict, unavailable and offline presentation
focused page/API/state tests, frontend/full profiles, local CR and real mini-program candidate evidence
mustNotChange: candidate/source/variant browse labels and draft sheet affordances
legacy stat snapshot as a separate status surface
legacy gearBySlot and enhancementBySlot compatibility fields
backend Resolve/Profile facts or public observed-only payload
PostgreSQL-only runtime and Phase 3A SLO/query/cache contract
evidenceRequired: forged client stats, set, legality and readiness cannot affect final panels or gates
exact Intent key allowlist and missing resolverContext fail-closed proof
out-of-order response proof that newest serial/version wins
one-time revision-only 409 rebase and repeated-conflict read-only proof
503 versus offline presentation and action gating proof
every save/import/reset/candidate/variant/enhancement caller routed through canonical confirmation
matching snapshot serializerInput for any legacy stat request and signature-bound save/Profile/SimC handoff
frontend/full profiles, local CR and exact-head GitHub Harness
real WeChat initial verified and confirmed edit pending-to-resolved evidence, plus safe problem/API limitation evidence
clean-main parity deployment and post-merge API/mini-program smoke

ownership.factOwner: backend Resolved Snapshot and Result Envelope; the page owns only draft choices, request ordering and display formatting
consumers: legacy stat snapshot request using matching serializer input

engineeringHealth.reason: Slice 3C reuses the existing page, Slice 3B pure state and Phase 3A APIs. It may delete or demote local final-fact helpers only after caller proof and adds no backend or persistence owner.

acceptanceEvidence: python3 -m unittest tests.gear_runtime_test tests.news_backend_test tests.websim_payload_test tests.postgres_cache_store_test
real WeChat route/action/screenshot evidence and candidate backend/API matrix

decisionLog.decision: Integrate the existing page instead of introducing a second UI or state framework.
Keep browse and draft affordances local, but move every final fact and action gate to the matching server snapshot.
Keep legacy stat snapshot separate and source its gear items only from current snapshot serializerInput until Phase 5.
Require candidate backend and real WeChat evidence before merge; safe unavailable cases may use direct API evidence when production mutation would be required.
